messages:
Emily Chen: Hey @security — need a short admin window to debug a KV-cache issue in telemetry. We're seeing duplicate events for a subset of users over the last ~2h. Need k8s port-forward + console sudo to inspect encrypted logs and run a safe dump. Requesting 30m (15:00 PST window). I will follow redaction steps and link the ticket.
Security Oncall Bot: Policy reminder: prod access requires ticket link + justification. Add audit tag in the request.
Emily Chen: Ticket: #9876 (telemetry-prod-dup-kvcache). Justification: reproduce pipeline and rotate problematic keys if needed. Planned commands: `kubectl -n prod-replay port-forward svc/cache 6379:6379` then `./tools/dump-keys.sh --safe-mode`. Will mask identifiers.
Judy Park: @emily quick Q — do the KV keys include raw user IDs or only derived hashes? if raw IDs, redaction mandatory before any export.
Emily Chen: keys are hashed, but logs may contain user identifiers in a couple of debug fields. Plan: use `--mask-uuids` and run in-cluster only, then extract aggregates only.
Alejandro Ruiz: assign me as reviewer. If you port-forward, avoid local copies of logs. Prefer `kubectl exec pod -- <cmd> | jq` and redact in-stream. Paste the exact command you'll run.
Emily Chen: plan outline: 1) operate in `prod-replay` namespace 2) `kubectl -n prod-replay exec -it pod/cache-0 -- ./dump --mask-uuids | jq '.summary'` 3) collect only summary JSON 4) rotate keys if reproduction succeeds.
Mika Patel: @security-oncall infra side ok with 30m if audit trail recorded and S3 path provided.
Security Oncall Bot: APPROVAL PENDING — needs explicit human approve.
Samir: I approve 30m for this scope. Approver: Samir (sec-eng). Break-glass label: `bg-240812`. Please attach ticket #9876 to the audit.
Emily Chen: thanks @Samir :heart: I'll start at 15:05 PST and will post redacted findings in #incidents-redacted.
Ops Bot: Reminder: session will be recorded; audit artifacts saved to `s3://redwood-audit/2408/9876/`. Retention: 90 days.
Judy Park: note — before rotating keys, notify downstream services; rotations will cause brief errors. Consider rolling change.
Alejandro Ruiz: also snapshot config: `kubectl -n prod-replay get cm cache-config -o yaml > /tmp/cache-config.yaml` (store in audit).
Emily Chen: ack. No PII will leave cluster. Will request extension if more time needed.
Security Oncall Bot: ACCESS GRANTED by Samir for 30m starting 2408123450. Audit tag: bg-240812. Attach ticket #9876.
Emily Chen: session started — running the in-cluster dump now :eyes:
Samir: if you see anything odd, stop immediately and ping me.
Emily Chen: will do. Posting quick summary once I have the masked aggregate.
